5ade304e-8e0e-4484-944a-18d8d08caf9f.name: Kerry Eurodyne
5ade304e-8e0e-4484-944a-18d8d08caf9f.rulesText:
When you roll in a Gig from your fixer area, you may ignore the result and reroll it once.
When you roll a min or max value on a Gig, draw 1. If it's a d20, draw 3 instead.

b217ae88-52a6-44b3-b021-964db4534dbd.name: River Ward
b217ae88-52a6-44b3-b021-964db4534dbd.displayName: River Ward: Detective on the Hunt
b217ae88-52a6-44b3-b021-964db4534dbd.rulesText:
{Quick} {Spend} Play a Gear with cost 2 or less from your hand for free.
When a friendly equipped Unit is defeated, search the top 2 cards of your deck and trash 1.

58cffb40-0914-4c6b-81cf-cdd8b2b83f17.name: Rockn' Rockerboy
58cffb40-0914-4c6b-81cf-cdd8b2b83f17.rulesText: [Flavor] Scream your throat raw for something. Anything.

ade4a2d5-df74-44fe-ab5f-222dc6e2ce27.name: Viktor Vektor
ade4a2d5-df74-44fe-ab5f-222dc6e2ce27.rulesText: Play your first CYBERWARE Gear each turn for -3 €$, to a minimum of 1 €$.

93f68b18-e15c-44be-883b-8db7990646f1.name: Jackie Welles
93f68b18-e15c-44be-883b-8db7990646f1.displayName: Jackie Welles: Ride or Die Choom
93f68b18-e15c-44be-883b-8db7990646f1.rulesText:
{Attack} Give this Unit +2 power this turn for each friendly Gig with an even value.
{Defeated} Draw 1 for each friendly Gig with an odd value.

dc0a7e03-54b6-4334-965f-27a3d469fed6.name: Mandibular Upgrade
dc0a7e03-54b6-4334-965f-27a3d469fed6.rulesText:
(Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.)
{Blocker} (You may spend this Unit to redirect a rival Unit's attack to it instead.)

ccb79cf1-fc2d-4b52-bea5-b427583bfe1b.name: Adrenaline Converter
ccb79cf1-fc2d-4b52-bea5-b427583bfe1b.rulesText:
(Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.)
If a Rival controls at least 2 more Gigs than you, this Unit has {Adrenaline}. (This Unit can attack the turn it's played.)

25077971-70cc-4524-b7cf-cd8258abc28c.name: Zetatech Faceplate
25077971-70cc-4524-b7cf-cd8258abc28c.rulesText:
(Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.)
When this Unit or Legend is spent, adjust a Gig by up to 1. Then, if you control 3 or more Gigs with different values, draw 1.

b2d6aeff-8fa3-4151-9e67-a83188a78197.name: Live with the Aftermath
b2d6aeff-8fa3-4151-9e67-a83188a78197.rulesText: Each player defeats one of their Units.

20c23b0f-187d-41d8-9670-b8e603049b3d.name: Bootleg Black Sapphire Show
20c23b0f-187d-41d8-9670-b8e603049b3d.rulesText:
Sell the top card of your deck.
If you control a Gig with an even value and a Gig with an odd value, draw 2.

1435b785-967e-48a7-8ef7-f7fecbb27aaf.name: Hanako Arasaka
1435b785-967e-48a7-8ef7-f7fecbb27aaf.displayName: Hanako Arasaka: Daughter of the Emperor
1435b785-967e-48a7-8ef7-f7fecbb27aaf.rulesText:
{Spend} Swap a friendly Gig with a rival Gig.
At the start of your turn, draw 1 for each friendly value-pair of Gigs.

c828bc68-23a3-41ef-878b-00b13ccf0cdc.name: Valentino Street Racer
c828bc68-23a3-41ef-878b-00b13ccf0cdc.rulesText: {Play} Give another friendly Unit with cost 5 or less {Adrenaline} this turn. (A Unit with Adrenaline can attack the turn it's played.)

786d5ce2-bfc0-4648-9c7d-323e939a1d34.name: Pepe Najarro
786d5ce2-bfc0-4648-9c7d-323e939a1d34.rulesText: {Attack} If you control a value-pair of Gigs, ready up to 2 MERC Legends in your Legends area.

27c1bf13-5f6b-4421-aa76-5789a94c9c1b.name: MaxTac AV
27c1bf13-5f6b-4421-aa76-5789a94c9c1b.rulesText: {Play} You may swap a friendly Gig with a rival Gig.

2cff513f-6a75-40f0-8e70-e1491d340472.name: Peace Offering
2cff513f-6a75-40f0-8e70-e1491d340472.rulesText: You may set a Gig's value to the value of another Gig. Then, if you control a value-pair, draw 1.

a7a49ccf-4b85-4997-b08c-16e8e80d9aa8.name: Take Control
a7a49ccf-4b85-4997-b08c-16e8e80d9aa8.rulesText: {Quick} A rival Unit steals 1 fewer Gig this turn. If that Unit is an AI, DRONE, or VEHICLE, draw 1.

7a8c2032-e753-43ab-9c3b-adefb4281241.name: Memory Relapse
7a8c2032-e753-43ab-9c3b-adefb4281241.rulesText: Spend a rival Unit. It can't ready until your next turn. If your ☆ (Street Cred) is an even number, draw 1.

873656f0-c32a-46fb-856f-8a5ee44b8d21.name: Alt Cunningham
873656f0-c32a-46fb-856f-8a5ee44b8d21.rulesText: 1 €$, {Spend} Play a Program from your trash. Bottom-deck it after you play it. (You still pay its cost.)

328cd3e4-4177-4d6a-86c0-00d1a5a12b38.name: Jackie Welles
328cd3e4-4177-4d6a-86c0-00d1a5a12b38.displayName: Jackie Welles: Pour One Out For Me
328cd3e4-4177-4d6a-86c0-00d1a5a12b38.rulesText: The first time you play a Blue Unit or Blue Gear each turn, you may decrease a friendly Gig by up to 2. If it becomes a min Gig, draw 1.

d74468ab-6024-4ae6-b69a-ac41f6e9cfce.name: Judy Álvarez
d74468ab-6024-4ae6-b69a-ac41f6e9cfce.rulesText:
When you play a BRAINDANCE Program, give a friendly Unit +1 power this turn.
{Spend} Trash the top card of your deck. If it's a Program, you may add it to your hand.

f18a73a9-fa29-4351-ad96-8e7c1dd0e8a1.name: Jacked-In Voodoo Boy
f18a73a9-fa29-4351-ad96-8e7c1dd0e8a1.rulesText: This Unit can't attack unless you played a Program this turn.

32f8d89a-1e4b-46b8-9323-77c297c5b5ae.name: Delamain
32f8d89a-1e4b-46b8-9323-77c297c5b5ae.rulesText:
{Play} Draw 2.
(Units with power 0 don't steal Gigs.)

859345fa-c791-49dc-9258-505982b5adea.name: Mox Inciters
859345fa-c791-49dc-9258-505982b5adea.rulesText:
{Play} A rival Unit must attack next turn if it can.
{Blocker} (You may spend this Unit to redirect a rival Unit's attack to it instead.)

6b5606c9-12a2-46d6-b13f-a672c6bd5f07.name: Rita Wheeler
6b5606c9-12a2-46d6-b13f-a672c6bd5f07.rulesText:
{Blocker} (You may spend this Unit to redirect a rival Unit's attack to it instead.)
The first time this Unit is spent each turn, draw 1, then discard 1.

929b5e98-ab82-4e36-bb72-a00a223ded77.name: Lizzy Wizzy
929b5e98-ab82-4e36-bb72-a00a223ded77.rulesText:
{Play} You may play a Program with cost 3 or less from your hand or trash for free. Bottom-deck it after you play it.
{Blocker}

220bef49-2e98-4bc6-b023-5bb8f492b29b.name: Maman Brigitte
220bef49-2e98-4bc6-b023-5bb8f492b29b.rulesText: {Play} You may discard 2 Programs. If you do, bottom-deck a rival unequipped Unit.

0ff059f8-90c3-47ef-ba3b-cd380f30f14e.name: Placide
0ff059f8-90c3-47ef-ba3b-cd380f30f14e.rulesText: {Play} {Attack} You may discard 1 Program. If you do, bottom-deck a rival Unit.

e2a34251-d2d9-46e0-9840-ca69a358a6ae.name: NetWatch Netdriver
e2a34251-d2d9-46e0-9840-ca69a358a6ae.rulesText:
(Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.)
When this Unit or Legend is spent, draw 1.

859c8d1d-b715-4a9a-b7cc-96ecfe135a00.name: Floor It
859c8d1d-b715-4a9a-b7cc-96ecfe135a00.rulesText: {Quick} Give a rival Unit -1 power this turn. Draw 1.

f9a81013-9c64-4e48-8d1d-cd1b41b72ee0.name: Trust No One
f9a81013-9c64-4e48-8d1d-cd1b41b72ee0.rulesText: Decrease a Gig by up to 3. Then, if you control a min Gig, draw 1.

0449bc78-983b-4681-b062-0738de3c487b.name: Three Mouths, One Desire
0449bc78-983b-4681-b062-0738de3c487b.rulesText: Search the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 to your hand. You may add 1 more for each friendly min Gig. Bottom-deck the rest.

0be394e3-ce41-4f16-a95b-33ec951bf43c.name: Chrome Reverie
0be394e3-ce41-4f16-a95b-33ec951bf43c.rulesText: A rival Unit can't attack until your next turn. If you control a min Gig, you may Call a Legend for free. (You can only Call a Legend once per turn.)

dfd5d1df-2b47-4ddd-9d6a-35430a892cfc.name: Nocturne OP55 N1
dfd5d1df-2b47-4ddd-9d6a-35430a892cfc.rulesText:
If your fixer area is empty, play this Program for 1 €$. Choose one effect.
Draw 2. // A Unit can't attack until your next turn. // A friendly Legend may use {Go Solo} for -2 €$ this turn, to a minimum of 1 €$.

bab79ef1-57fb-4b24-b50a-e08899699862.name: Pyramid Song
bab79ef1-57fb-4b24-b50a-e08899699862.rulesText:
Choose one effect. If a friendly d4 is a min Gig, choose both instead.
Give a rival Unit -5 power this turn. // Bottom-deck a rival Unit with power 0.

7e86c639-5225-4a91-be33-6ab86c9adfe2.name: Les Élémens
7e86c639-5225-4a91-be33-6ab86c9adfe2.rulesText: Bottom-deck a Rival's lowest-power Unit. (If there are multiple, choose 1.)
